layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing, mobile-first design, edge-to-edge imagery in cards, heavy use of whitespace between sections to create a premium feel.
layout_and_spacing.container: px-6 md:px-12 w-full max-w-lg mx-auto md:max-w-4xl

motion_system.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward motion (framer-motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion_system.interactions: All buttons and cards must have a spring-based scale-down effect on tap/click (whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}).
motion_system.lists: Stagger children entrances by 0.05s for category pills and business cards.

homepage_hero.description: Massive typography, pure curiosity, no navigation. Just the headline, subheadline, and giant CTA.
homepage_hero.styles: min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-6 relative bg-[#050505]

giant_cta_button.description: The 'I'M DOWN {CITY}' button. Must feel addictive to click.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark mode background with subtle noise texture and pink edge glow. Use as a fixed full-screen background image behind the app with opacity-40.
Close-up luxury cocktail on dark table. Use as a placeholder image for businesses in the 'Drinks' category.
Live music crowd with magenta lights. Use as a placeholder image for businesses in the 'Live Music' category.
Moody luxury restaurant setting. Use as a placeholder image for businesses in the 'Food' or 'Date Night' category.

accessibility.aria_labels: Ensure all icon buttons have descriptive aria-labels. Category pills should read aloud the emoji and category name.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Background must be #050505, cards #121212. DO NOT use generic gray or purple gradients.
Use standard semantic HTML elements wrapped in framer-motion (<motion.div>) for all interactions.
The homepage MUST ONLY contain the 'YOU'RE NOT DOWN?' headline, 'Let's find out.' subhead, and the giant 'I'M DOWN {CITY}' button. Absolutely NO nav bar, NO footer, NO menus on this initial screen.
For typography, import 'Clash Display' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts or standard Fontsource packages. Do not use Inter or Roboto.
All interactive elements (buttons, cards, links) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case for automated testing.

The admin dashboard requires Google OAuth integration. Use standard shadcn UI components (tables, dialogs, forms) but strip them of the default Vercel look by applying the dark theme colors (#121212 surfaces, #050505 background).
Ensure the app feels like a native mobile app. Use `min-h-screen`, hide scrollbars (`scrollbar-hide`), and make hit areas large (min 44px height for buttons).
Write all frontend code in .js / .jsx (not TypeScript), as requested.
